title: Findings: observation records (audited, no diff) as a first-class entity kind
context: Coverage audit (programmer/product/lead) showed every Hunch entity anchors to a commit/diff, so knowledge with no diff had no home: an audit that surfaced unscoped tenant queries, a measured number, an incident with no code fix. Constraint.violations was a dead field (written by nothing, read by nothing). Record count tracked capture-ritual strength (Runbook: full schema, 1 record), so the design covers all three axes: schema, capture ritual, grounding trigger.
decision: New 'findings' entity kind (fnd_*, id seeded by lowercased title for idempotent re-record). Anchor is observed_at + evidence, not a commit; lifecycle is triage (open/accepted-risk/scheduled/resolved/stale), not valid-time supersession. Rides the unified FTS index like runbooks — no dedicated SQL table. Advisory everywhere, never a block path: live findings inject into assembleContext (pre-edit hook + hunch_context), MCP hunch_record_finding/hunch_findings, CLI hunch findings, /audit slash-command ritual, deterministic finding-stale drift (missing affected file, dangling/retired violates_constraint), and git-backed staleness (file changed after observed_at). Resolving requires resolved_commit — a resolution claim needs the fixing commit.
consequences: Legacy graphs load unchanged (new kind + fully-defaulted fields; no SCHEMA_VERSION bump — missing findings/ dir loads empty)
An agent editing a file inherits past audits of that file automatically
CLAUDE.md counts line advertises open findings only when nonzero
alternatives_rejected: Reusing Constraint.violations for audit results: bare strings with no date/evidence/triage, and written/read by nothing — a dead field, not a model; revisit if findings and constraint violations ever need to merge

One catch-all observation entity with a kind discriminator (finding|measurement|fact|incident): kind:'misc' becomes a dumping ground; separate schemas can follow the proven Finding shape later; revisit if Measurement/Fact land and share >80% of the schema
A dedicated SQLite findings table: dec_d32af7b821 established new kinds ride the unified FTS+graph index; a table adds schema churn for no query need
Valid-time supersession lifecycle (like decisions): an observation is not an answer that gets replaced — it gets triaged; supersession semantics would force fake topics
Blocking enforcement for critical findings: a finding is evidence, not a rule; enforcement belongs to constraints (link via violates_constraint), keeping the model-out-of-the-block-path guarantee
